title: Hinomori Shiho — Not Used To Makeup〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's get right back into it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That reminds me. As I mentioned last time, we'll be holding a joint practice with the cast during the second half.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: First, let's start from the top and review everything we've done until now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nakanishi, can you count us in?

rows.Speaker: Nakanishi
rows.Line:
Okay! Ready, everyone?!
One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Good, we're all in sync.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The people who kept falling behind because they were being overly conscious are keeping up just fine with the others now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was a little worried that I was being too pushy or demanding again...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But they've been willing to put up with me.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They've put in a ton of effort, so I want them all to have as much fun as they possibly can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which is why we need to do our best when we have our joint practice with the cast today.)

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: The cast should be here soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Yeah, my friends in the cast said they're almost here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hi, thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Airi, Ichika, Emu & An
rows.Line:
Pardon us!
Pardon us.
Pardon us!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can we have a minute to warm up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, we'll begin our joint practice once the cast has had a chance to warm up. In the meantime, everyone in the band, let's take a break.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
I'm starting to get nervous again.
I know we're not playing in front of an audience or anything, but...

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
What if I mess up and ruin it for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori...
I'm starting to feel nervous again.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: B-But it's okay for us to mess up since we're just practicing, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That depends on who you ask.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In my case, I tend to believe that you shouldn't make any mistakes in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When you're up there for the main event, that's when you need to play your best and not make any mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, doesn't it make sense to keep that same mindset when you're practicing, and get as close to perfect as you can under conditions close to the real deal?

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Good point...
Still, it's amazing how you can push yourself to the limit like that.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Is that why I keep messing up during competitions and stuff? Do I need to be harder on myself?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Dunno...
Nerves just kind of happen, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it might be good to try a different approach and see if that helps.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I realize I'm contradicting myself, but remember, this is still practice.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Oh...
What she said!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Oh... M-Momoi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry for interrupting.
But I feel like I know exactly what you mean, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's important to do your best during practice, but there's still time to correct any mistakes you make! If at first you don't succeed, you just gotta try, try again!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More to the point, you've all been practicing really hard with Hinomori, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We heard Hinomori really runs people ragged during practices, so with you all managing to keep up, you guys are sure to sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You heard that, huh? Who from?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ichika☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But I genuinely believe that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, during our own practices, Shiho always looks so proud when she tells us how things are going here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's always saying how you're going to sound amazing when you play for real, and that's why she wants to make things as much fun for you as she can.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: We didn't know you felt that way, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Wow, I'm starting to feel a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We got to hear a part of your performance earlier. We knocked once you'd reached a place to stop.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought you all sounded amazing already the other day, but you sounded even better today. I got excited just listening to you guys play.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too! Before we came in, we were talking about how we can't wait to sing with this band!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, we're all really excited to hear you play!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hear that?
Now we really can't embarrass ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I'm not worried!
I mean, we've practiced a ton together now, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's blow the cast away by putting on an amazing performance for them!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Right!
